page1.text:
Something creeps along the road.
Something scary that kills people with each step it takes.
...I watch it go from a place slightly behind it.
I don't want to watch, but I can't turn away.

page2.text:
It's a scary dream.
A nightmare that I'll have to keep watching over and over.

page3.text:
But if I'm being honest, I've started to feel a slight closeness to it.
I was afraid at first, but I'm used to seeing it now.
Above all, this child doesn't have a bad heart.
It just eats in a different way than we do. It's a lot like me.

page5.text:
...Tonight is the same.
Why do they all come up to it?
Maybe it has something that draws men in.
No matter how many people it kills,
no matter how many days this goes on,
all it needs to draw in food is to walk around at night.

page6.text:
It eats.
At first, it ate in a rush, but it's gotten the hang of this.
There's no need to hurry.
Once they're pulled in by their feet, it's over.
It eats up their heart and mind without leaving a single drop.

page7.text:
Giggle and sing, go-go.
It's in a good mood tonight.
Even though it's never shown any emotion before now, it's giddy tonight.

page8.text:
That makes me feel closer to it, too.
I'm very happy tonight.
After all, it's the first time.
The first time Senpai sought me out himself.
...Yeah.
So there's nothing to be afraid of anymore.
I'll still have these scary dreams, but they're no problem at all.
The world seems so beautiful and kind because Senpai is looking at me.

page9.text:
So, I start to think that even this bad dream could go on a little longer, and I set out in search of my next meal.
Unfortunately,
"Working hard, I see. You've taken double your usual number, tonight."
I run into someone who's even scarier than this dream.

page10.text:
I run away.
The thing has never been afraid of anything before, but it flees in terror from this man.
Golden hair and red eyes.
He smells like me.
I've seen him before, once.
"Die while you can, girl. Once it takes a liking to you, you won't even be able to do that."
He's the golden Servant who warned me to kill myself.

page11.text:
"                "
I run.
From what?
I run.
From whom?
I run.
Why?

page12.text:
My dream won't end.
The thing looks so pitiful as it panics and runs into an alleyway.
It's all over for it now.
"I took you for a failed Holy Grail, but you've become far more complete than I anticipated. It's too bad, really."

page13.text:
"It is I who will carry out the selection. Before you die, curse yourself for being too suitable."
In an instant, countless blades stab the thing.

page14.text:
...Huh?
That's weird. It hurts.
She's the one who got stabbed, so why am I in pain when I'm watching from over here?
She's the one who's dying, so why am I on the ground?
I'm the one who's dreaming, so why...

page15.text: Why is my body cut to ribbons?

page16.text:
"H...uh?"
Ouch.
I'm in a dream, but it hurts, Senpai.
Something's spilling out of my stomach. I must look so pathetic.

page17.text:
"It...hurts."
I try to put the squishy things back inside, but my hands are playing somewhere else.
My feet... I have feet, but the body they're attached to is dangling around.

page18.text:
"No..."
When I try to say something, it hurts like I've been struck by lightning.
But I can't move, so I can't get away.
Why am I...

page19.text: "Still breathing? How filthily you cling to life, girl."

page20.text:
He has no mercy.
The golden man snaps a finger, and a blade bigger than my own body chops my head off.

page21.text:
"Oh..."
A nightmare.
This is a nightmare.
It's just like the dreams I've had so far.
It isn't really happening. Once I open my eyes, I'll be back in Senpai's house.

page22.text:
...See? I'm about to wake up.
Because it hurts so much.
It hurts so much I want to die, so unless I wake up, I really will...!

page23.text:
"Ah... Argh, ahhh!!!"
But I can't wake up.
I can't wake up from this dream.
Help.
Help, it hurts, help, help.
I need to hurry and wake up or else it'll take me with it—

page24.text:
But I can't wake up.
I can't wake up from this dream.
This dream.
I can't get out of this dream, Senpai—

page25.text:
And then, the woman falls.
She sprawls on the ground like an insect pinned to a museum plaque, her entire body skewered by Noble Phantasms.

page27.text:
The woman is still conscious.
Her life is far beyond saving, but she doesn't know when to quit, and keeps trying to move her limbs.

page28.text:
"Hmph. Still breathing? How filthily you cling to life, girl."
He hands down her death sentence with disdain.
The golden man—the Heroic Spirit named Gilgamesh mercilessly lets the final stroke fall.

page29.text: "Don't...want to...die... Senpai finally...looked at...me... I wanted him to...touch me...more..."

page30.text:
The woman must not be seeing anything anymore.
As if in a trance, she speaks a mundane wish in her final moments.
Finally.
Just when she'd finally grabbed hold of a small sliver of happiness, reaching for that shred of cloth,

page31.text:
"No... I don't want to die, I don't want to die...!
Because...if I die now, Nee-san will take him...!"

page32.text:
"You offend my sight. How dare you make me work so hard."
The executioner's sword falls.
The dream is over.
The woman's mind sinks into a pool of blood and disappears into the dirty alley floor, never to wake again.

page33.text:
"...Mm?"
By the time he turns around, it's too late.

page34.text:
"You—you've already grown this fa—!?!?!?"
It consumes him from his feet.
There's no escape.
Because he's already—

page35.text: It takes a while longer than usual.

page36.text: "...It hurts. I don't have much, so I can't heal."

page37.text:
She starts walking.
Her stomach is growling.
The only thought that drives her is hunger.
Even the King of Heroes, worth hundreds of thousands of souls, isn't enough to sate her?

page39.text:
She cries out as if in a fever dream.
But this is no dream.
It's the first time she goes into the breeding cage on her own.
